image_description: A black assault rifle, resembling an M4 or AR-15 platform, resting on a white cardboard box in an indoor setting with wood-paneled walls. The firearm features a collapsible stock, pistol grip, detachable magazine, handguard, and upper receiver with a carrying handle/optics rail.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Compact automatic firearm with characteristic profile of barrel receiver and stock aligned linearly.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly shows the linear alignment of the stock, receiver, and barrel typical of the AR platform.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Overall length is substantial with barrel comprising a significant portion of total length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The barrel and handguard assembly make up roughly half the visible length of the weapon, consistent with carbine proportions.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Matte black or dark gray finish.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The firearm exhibits a uniform matte black finish on both metal and polymer components.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Metallic receiver housing firing mechanism with detachable box magazine inserted below.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The lower receiver is visible with a standard STANAG-style magazine inserted into the magwell.
The barrel extends through the handguard and terminates in a visible flash hider/muzzle device.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Pistol grip collapsible or fixed stock and handguard surrounding barrel.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct pistol grip, a telescoping stock, and a ribbed handguard are all clearly present.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Parkerized or anodized metal with polymer furniture.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visual texture differences suggest metal receivers and polymer stock/grip/handguard, consistent with standard manufacturing.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Upper receiver has carrying handle or Picatinny rail for optics.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The upper receiver features a prominent carrying handle with integrated rear sight, characteristic of older M4/M16 variants.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Distinguishing features include magazine well and ejection port.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The magazine well is clearly defined around the magazine, and the ejection port cover area is visible on the right side of the receiver.

selected_experts.reason: To verify the specific model variant (e.g., M4 vs M16) and ensure it matches the 'assault rifle' class label accurately.
To check for structural integrity of the long barrel and ensure the rifle sits correctly on the box without floating or merging artifacts.
To inspect complex boundaries like the trigger guard, magazine release, and stock adjustment lever for melting or fusion errors.
To analyze the legibility of the text on the white box, as AI often generates gibberish text in background elements.

focus_areas: Magazine well geometry and insertion angle
Connection between stock and receiver buffer tube
Text legibility on the supporting box
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the mechanical logic of the firearm. Does the magazine align correctly with the well? Is the stock extension tube physically plausible? Check the text on the box for coherence, as this is a common failure point for generative models even if the main subject is perfect.
